description: Acceleration Response of a Six-Story Reinforced Concrete Building under Ambient Conditions and Impact Loads is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Fuat Aras, Istanbul Medeniyet University (medenlyet.edu.tr). Two sets of acceleration data obtained from a six-story reinforced concrete building under ambient and forced conditions have been presented. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Acceleration data, building vibration, dynamic survey, system identification, ambient vibration survey, impact loads. Published 2023-10-27. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
